text:
alex: Heads-up — someone used the office blender and left a mango cyclone in there this morning. Can the smoothie crew please rinse? :sweat_smile:

maria: omg that was me, sorry! got distracted on a call. I'll clean it now and add a label to the blender to avoid future carnage. :raised_hands:

sam: Suggestion: keep a small spill kit under the sink (paper towels, 70% alcohol wipes, a rubber spatula). I can bring one tomorrow.

jen: Also... we should finalize a 'sharp object' rule for the communal cutting board. Unsupervised breadknife episodes are a risk. :grimacing:

maria: Agreed. Maybe we put a breadknife holder with a sign 'Ask in kitchen channel before using' — sounds dramatic but reduces mystery knives.

sophie: Quick poll: would people be OK with a dedicated office cutting board + breadknife combo that lives in a locked drawer and must be signed out? React with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.

kitchen-bot: [auto] Fridge inventory update: oat milk (1 open), almond milk (2 sealed), bananas (3), chia pudding (0). Reminder: label leftovers with name + date.

alex: Poll results so far: 6 👍, 1 👎. I'll buy a cheap labeled drawer caddy and a sharp-safety sleeve for the knife.

maria: To avoid smoothie guilt, I'll post a one-line 'blender etiquette' note: "If you use it, rinse and run a quick hot-water spin or throw parts in the dishwasher" — concise.

sam: love that. Also, can someone bring extra travel cups? Our reusable mug pile is getting existential.

jen: I'll bring 6 collapsible cups Friday. Also adding a small whiteboard near the sink: "Missing Tupperware? Check under desk 12" :memo:

sophie: thanks! PS: can we add 'no raw fish' policy to the fridge? Last week was scary. :nauseated_face:

alex: agreed — let's keep pungent foods in sealed boxes and label them. Also adding 'spill kit' checklist to the drawer.

maria: I can design a tiny printable label for the blender + knife sign. Will drop in #design-assets tomorrow.

kitchen-bot: [auto] New item logged: 'Spill kit' by sam on 2026-03-24.

alex: awesome, thanks everyone. Smoothie truce? Anyone want mango smoothie at 3pm? I'll share.

sophie: yes please! :raised_hands:
